text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!
choice_data_list: Are you all right, Lady Rose?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After Rose Kingdom sustained injuries that
were by no means minor,
I brought her to the infirmary to be
treated.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To say there's no problem...
would be a lie.
Yet it is precisely because this is an
emergency...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I must consider this carefully.
How one ought to conduct oneself at a time
like this.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Injury and illness visit everyone alike...
Regardless of station or status.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No, look at it another way:
how one handles it might be what truly
defines their status and standing.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
In other words,
anyone who aspires to be a king—
anyone who desires
to be a sovereign—must face it head-on.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Only those who overcome adversity and
bloom...
can truly be king.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I know not how things will turn out.
Yet I intend to test the limits of my
caliber.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Let me hear your thoughts.
choice_data_list: A king's foremost duty is to endure.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To endure...
To sustain life, you mean?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
A royal house has meaning only if it
endures.
Collapsing here accomplishes nothing.
If so—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I shall remain quiet for now,
if that is what you ask of me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a time,
Rose Kingdom rested in seclusion,
like a flower quietly sheltering in the
shade.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Do not worry.
You know as well as anyone
that I was born under a fortunate star.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Now then,
whether I possess the caliber of a king...
remains to be seen.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me... Was I overconfident?
To think I harmed not only the flower,
but the roots as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It appears what I required was not courage,
but prudence...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rose Kingdom's injury worsened,
forcing her to endure an extended period of
rest...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Good, it appears I succeeded. A king is,
after all,
one who carves out a path by their own
will.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
That is why so many believe and follow.
The Kingdom of Roses lies—
at the end of this very path.
